Name: Elnaam, Father of Jeribai
Summary: Father of Jeribai and Joshaviah among David's mighty men.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 11:46: Father of Jeribai and Joshaviah among David's mighty men.
LifeLesson: The mention of Elnaam in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
